gap: Almost everything a rich player can buy, they buy once.The only things that come back are small (bar, antes, gem rolls, radio), capped (the bill), or optional and edged (the casino, cashing into ZCoins). Gear isn't a lasting sink either: it refunds within the hour and sells back later. And the tracker misses a few flows both ways (the bar, island tiers, cashing to ZCoins; the Jackpot Thief, the Prize Wheel, Marked Cards, pet and gem sales), so the daily in-and-out won't add up to the change in what's held until those are tagged. That's a small fix and the first thing to build.
